map.→ 打开两个不相干声源的总声级工具: -> Open the total sound level of two unrelated sources tool
map.两个不相干声源的总声级 使用指南: Total sound level of two unrelated sources user guide
map.两台设备同时运行，求合成总声压级而非简单相加。: Two devices running together: compute the combined total sound pressure level rather than simply adding them.
map.为什么不能把 dB 直接相加？: Why can decibels not simply be added?
map.分贝是对数量级，代表能量比；叠加须把声压/声功率还原成能量（10^(L/10)）: Decibels are logarithmic and represent energy ratios, so combining sources requires converting sound pressure/power back to energy (10^(L/10)), summing, and taking the log again.
map.噪声治理后核算降噪前后总声级变化。: Recheck the total sound level before and after noise control.
map.声压级能量叠加器，输入两个不相干声源的声压级，按对数能量叠加求总声级，用于多噪声: Sound pressure level energy combiner: enter the sound pressure levels of two unrelated sources and combine them logarithmically in energy to get the total level, for assessing the total sound pressure of multiple noise sources.
map.直达声与混响声相等的临界距离: Critical distance where direct sound equals reverberant sound
map.相差很大的两个声级叠加会怎样？: What happens when two sound levels that differ a lot are combined?
map.若差 ≥10 dB，较小者几乎不影响总值，总声级约等于较大者（误差 <0.5 d: If the difference is >=10 dB the smaller one barely affects the total, so the total level is about equal to the larger one (error <0.5 dB).
map.输入两个声压级，求能量叠加后的总声级。: Enter two sound pressure levels to get the total level after energy combination.
map.验证“加一个相同声源只升 3 dB”的常识。: Verify the common claim that "adding one identical source only raises the level by 3 dB".
map.：两台相同机器各 80 dB，总声级 L=10·log10(10^8+10^8): : two identical machines at 80 dB each give a total L=10·log10(10^8+10^8)=10·log10(2·10^8)≈83.0 dB, so equal levels combined only add 3 dB rather than 160 dB.
